preparationHook:
-- Fixed temporary Studio acceptance only; not part of repository entry/build.
local qa=Instance.new('BindableFunction');qa.Name='BrickToadsWalkerQA';qa.Parent=game.ServerStorage
local data={events={},phases={}};local seen,lastPhase,lastSample=nil,'',0;local stopOn
local function current()local c=controller.groups['group-1'].controller;return c,c.world,c.current,c.director end
local function pose(w,id,x,z,dx,dz)
 local a=assert(w.actors[id]);local p=Vector3.new(x,3,z)+w.offset
 a.model:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(p,p+Vector3.new(dx or 1,0,dz or 0)));a.root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero;a.root.AssemblyAngularVelocity=Vector3.zero
end
local function pause(w,d)
 for id,e in d.enemies do if not e.dead then
  e.nextAttack=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()+3600;e.windup=nil;e.rushing=nil
  local a=w.actors[id];if a then a.root.Anchored=true;w:move(id,0,0) end
 end end
end
local function inspect()
 local c,w,s,d=current();if not s then return {ready=false}end
 local actors,clubs={},{}
 for id,a in w.actors do if id>-1000 then
  actors[tostring(id)]={position=w:position(id),velocity=tostring(a.root.AssemblyLinearVelocity),move=tostring(a.humanoid.MoveDirection),
   speed=a.humanoid.WalkSpeed,state=a.humanoid:GetState().Name,identity=a.model:GetAttribute('ActorId'),health=a.model:GetAttribute('HealthRaw'),
   action=a.model:GetAttribute('PrimaryAttack'),phase=a.model:GetAttribute('AttackPhase'),anchored=a.root.Anchored}
 end end
 for id,item in d.clubs.items do clubs[id]={state=item.state,slot=item.slot,position=item.position}end
 return {session=s:snapshot(),level=d:snapshot(),actors=actors,clubs=clubs,heroInteraction=d:interaction(1),events=data.events,phases=data.phases}
end
local function initial()
 local c,w,s,d=current();pause(w,d);pose(w,1,-65,0,1);pose(w,-3,-58,0,-1)
 pose(w,-1,-30,20,-1);pose(w,-2,-20,-20,-1)
end
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
 local c,w,s,d=current();if not s then return end
 if seen~=s then
  seen=s;local old=s.logger
  s.logger=function(row)
   if old then old(row)end
   if row.kind=='Hit' or row.kind=='ClubSpawned' or row.kind=='ClubPickedUp' then
    table.insert(data.events,row)
    if row.kind=='Hit' and stopOn and stopOn[row.data.action]then pause(w,d);stopOn=nil end
   end
  end
  initial()
 end
 local now=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
 if now-lastSample>.04 then
  lastSample=now;local phases={}
  for id,e in d.enemies do if e.kind=='Walker' and not e.dead then
   local a=w.actors[id];phases[tostring(id)]={action=a.model:GetAttribute('PrimaryAttack'),phase=a.model:GetAttribute('AttackPhase'),pending=e.windup and e.windup.action}
  end end
  local encoded=HttpService:JSONEncode(phases)
  if encoded~=lastPhase then lastPhase=encoded;table.insert(data.phases,{at=now,heroes=s:snapshot().heroes,actors=phases})end
 end
end)
qa.OnInvoke=function(action)
 local c,w,s,d=current();assert(s,'Start first')
 if action=='humanReady' then
  assert(d.enemies[-3].ownerUserId,'Claim the actual Walker offer first')
  w.actors[-3].root.Anchored=false;d.enemies[-3].nextAttack=workspace:GetServerTimeNow();stopOn={WalkerLight=true}
 elseif action=='whiff' then
  pause(w,d);pose(w,1,-65,0,1);pose(w,-3,-58,0,-1)
  w.actors[-3].root.Anchored=false;d.enemies[-3].nextAttack=workspace:GetServerTimeNow();stopOn=nil
 elseif action=='fly' then
  pause(w,d);d:_enterZone(2);d:_enterZone(3);pause(w,d)
  pose(w,1,174.5,-5,1)
  for id,e in d.enemies do if not e.dead then pose(w,id,220+(id%3)*3,id%2==0 and 20 or -20,-1)end end
  assert(s:_hit(-7,1,'PigRush'))
  task.delay(.9,function()pose(w,1,174.5,-5,1)end)
 elseif action=='heavyWindow' then
  assert(s.combat[1].rawLife==39,'Catch the real fly first')
  pause(w,d);pose(w,1,178,0,1);pose(w,-7,182.5,0,-1);pose(w,-3,171.5,0,1)
  w.actors[-3].root.Anchored=false;d.enemies[-3].nextAttack=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
  d.enemies[-7].nextAttack=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()+.2;stopOn={WalkerHeavy=true}
 elseif action=='npcLight' then
  pause(w,d)
  for id,e in d.enemies do if not e.dead then pose(w,id,220+(id%3)*3,id%2==0 and 20 or -20,-1)end end
  pose(w,1,178,0,1);pose(w,-6,184.4,0,-1);d.enemies[-6].nextAttack=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()+.3;stopOn={WalkerLight=true}
 elseif action=='retreat' then
  pause(w,d);pose(w,1,178,0,1);pose(w,-6,179.5,0,-1);w.actors[-6].root.Anchored=false;stopOn=nil
 elseif action=='edge' then
  pause(w,d);pose(w,1,180,24.5,0,1);pose(w,-6,180,26,0,-1);w.actors[-6].root.Anchored=false;stopOn=nil
 elseif action=='defeat' then
  pause(w,d);pose(w,1,178,0,1);pose(w,-6,183.5,0,-1);stopOn=nil
 elseif action=='inspect' then return inspect()
 else error('Unknown fixed action')end
 return inspect()
end
limits: Native contracts cover both shields, NPC friendly fire, takeover/offline, old windup interruption and duplicate/fall drop paths. These were not additional multiplayer engine scenarios. Engine NPC heavy was not separately run; actual human primary heavy and actual NPC light plus shared native selection are separate evidence. Physical target hop/precise source gait/retreat/cadence/health, natural full combat route, additional groups, physical phones/tablets and actual same-account reconnect remain open.
